name: Dumbbell Neutral-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench with feet planted and set your shoulder blades back against the pad.
Hold a dumbbell above each shoulder with palms facing each other and arms extended.
Bend your elbows close to your ribs to lower the dumbbells beside your chest, keeping handles parallel.
Press both dumbbells smoothly upward until your elbows straighten above your chest.
tips: Keep both wrists stacked directly over your elbows throughout.
Lower with control and avoid bouncing the dumbbells off your torso.
